problem:
Let $T$ be the linear transformation with matrix representation $T$ given by

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}5 & 0 \\ 0 & 5\end{aligned}].
$$

A line segment $\overset{―}{EF}$ has endpoints at $E(1,1)$ and $F(2,3).$ What are the coordinates of the corresponding endpoints $\overset{―}{{E}^{′}{F}^{′}}$, the image of $\overset{―}{EF}$ under the action of $T?$

${E}^{′}($ 
{{field-1}}, 
{{field-2}}
$)\,$ and $\,{F}^{′}($ 
{{field-3}}, 
{{field-4}}
$)$
worked_solution:
To find the image of $\overset{―}{EF}$ under the action of $T$, we first create a matrix $X$ containing the coordinates of the endpoints of $\overset{―}{EF}:$

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 1 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, we compute the image of $X$ under the action of $T$ by calculating the matrix product $TX:$

$$
\begin{aligned}TX & =[\begin{aligned}5 & 0 \\ 0 & 5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 1 & 3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5 & 10 \\ 5 & 15\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the coordinates of the respective endpoints of the image are ${E}^{′}(5,5)$ and ${F}^{′}(10,15).$
